Ticket:
Missing lab results coming through our interface

Hello, I am a bit perplexed by what is happening with our diagnostic feeds today. Usually, the blood work and pathology reports from our main regional lab drop straight into our incoming queue by morning, but nothing has appeared since Tuesday. I checked the integration settings tab and the green connection indicator is lit up, so I am not sure why the actual data packets are not populating. We have several patients waiting for their follow-up reviews, so any light you can shed on why the conduit seems quiet would be greatly appreciated.
